approach: A drop in beat frequency after reducing the tension in A shows that the frequency of A moved closer to the frequency of B.

steps.text: Write the two frequencies that fit the original beat of 8 Hz with the frequency of A equal to 320 Hz.
Reducing the tension in a string lowers its frequency, so the new frequency of A is slightly below 320 Hz.
Test each candidate. If f_B = 328 Hz, lowering f_A moves it away from 328 Hz, so the beat frequency would rise, not fall to 4 Hz.
If f_B = 312 Hz, lowering f_A moves it towards 312 Hz, so the beat frequency falls, matching the observed drop to 4 Hz.
steps.why_this_step: Only the candidate that makes the gap shrink when f_A falls is consistent with the observation.

common_mistakes.text: Picking 328 Hz because it is also 8 Hz away from 320 Hz, without checking which direction the beat frequency actually moves.
